title: data set: dispatch data — branch grammar, preflight members, dispatch-manifest schema
description: Round 5 of #598, items 8-10. The registered branch grammar: both perpetually-valid forms (session-scoped feature/<slug>, verified against kickoff's create_worktree at launch.rs:345; the display-ID form for post-sync branches; provisional local IDs never enter branch names) with the refs-query seam and pre-push warn-toward-preferred conduct. The five autonomous-dispatch preflight members with per-member observation bindings, three-valued fail-closed semantics, and the dispatch-failed fencing rule for late writers. The dispatch-manifest schema: the recording fields Recorded review dispatch enumerates, shipped as versioned data so parity queries read manifests as data. Owner: data-engineer. Validator: solution-architect.

comments.content: ADOPTION ADDENDUM (2026-07-21, from round-1 finding #688): the branch-grammar exempt-refs set — main, the chassis's own branches (crosslink/hub, crosslink/knowledge), and operator-created archive refs recorded on the tracker (wip-archive) — is OPERATOR-ADOPTED as part of this set's adoption. The exemption list was necessary from the start (the refs query would otherwise flag main) but its adoption went unrecorded; recorded now, late-marked, per the registered-data-not-convention rule the grammar clause exists to enforce.
